decision.rationale: TXN-008104 is a purchase of 22820 EUR minor units at Bramble Devices (MER-000005) on card CRD-000010. It posted on 2026-08-15, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-31. That is 77 days, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000065) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-22. The dispute was opened 70 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The case has no carrier delivery confirmation, so nothing shows the goods were delivered. The cardholder's email of 2026-08-31 (DOC-000066) shows they asked the merchant where the order was and got no reply. There are no refunds on the card, so the merchant has not resolved the matter. Under goods-not-received-merchant-evidence, the next step is to ask the merchant for proof of delivery to the cardholder.

proposed_actions.note: For the order placed on 2026-08-14 for 228.20 EUR, please send proof of delivery: the carrier's delivery record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, with the recipient's signature.
